title: Lewis Hamilton's Almave Mocktails Launch at Target
summary: Lewis Hamilton launches Almave's non-alcoholic Margarita and Paloma exclusively at 1,100 Target stores Nov. 10. Get the story behind the brand.
body_markdown:
Formula 1 driver and entrepreneur **Lewis Hamilton** launched Almave's new ready-to-drink non-alcoholic cocktails exclusively at Target on Nov. 10. Available in approximately 1,100 stores, the new lineup includes[Classic Margarita](https://www.target.com/p/almave-non-alcoholic-margarita-4pk-12-fl-oz-cans/-/A-1011205025#lnk=sametab) , featuring bright citrus flavors, and[Paloma](https://www.target.com/p/almave-non-alcoholic-paloma-4pk-12-fl-oz-cans/-/A-1011205026#lnk=sametab) , with refreshing grapefruit notes.


Arriving just in time for holiday entertaining and ahead of the increasingly popular Dry January, Almave’s premium alcohol-free offerings tap into a growing lifestyle shift toward mindful drinking and wellness. It's another way Target is meeting guests' evolving needs and building on its merchandising authority with culturally relevant products at an incredible value.


Made with real blue agave, the cocktails build on the brand's existing non-alcoholic tequila and mezcal spirits already sold at Target. Guests can shop each flavor in a four-pack for $12.99 or try both in a Target-exclusive[six-pack variety pack](https://www.target.com/p/almave-non-alcoholic-margarita-paloma-variety-pack-6pk-12-fl-oz-cans/-/A-1011205027#lnk=sametab) for $17.99.


We asked Lewis about the inspiration behind Almave's latest launch, his approach to mindful drinking and why Target is the right partner for the brand's next chapter.


Q:


What did you learn from creating Almave’s non-alcoholic agave spirit that influenced how you approached these ready-to-drink non-alcoholic cocktails?


A:


We learned that drinkers care about authenticity and craftsmanship as much as we do. So when we began developing our ready-to-drink non-alcoholic cocktails, it was important to carry those same qualities forward.


That meant using real ingredients, including real blue agave in every can. A great Margarita or Paloma has layers to it, and we worked to make sure that same level of layers, sophistication and taste was in every can. Our standards had to be high to earn our place on the shelf, and our benchmark was simple: to be the best-tasting option.


Non-alcohlic options have been an afterthought for too long, and we wanted to change that. These are proper cocktails, made with the know-how of a master distiller, so I hope they grab a can, give it a go and think, "Okay, that's really good."


Q:


When you think about Target guests picking up these non-alcoholic cocktails, what occasions or moments do you imagine them bringing Almave into?


A:


I think of the holidays first, like Friendsgiving or having family over, with everyone around the same table. Those are the moments when feeling included matters most. But they're also when the non-alcoholic option is usually an afterthought, and it rarely matches what everyone else is drinking.


Everyone at that table deserves a great cocktail in their hand, whether they want alcohol or not, which is why we're so excited to continue building on our Almave range.


Q:


Almave’s non-alcoholic agave spirit is already at Target, and now the new cocktails are coming exclusively to Target. What makes Target the right partner for this next chapter of the brand?


A:


Target shoppers already know Almave from the spirits, so bringing the cocktails to the same shelves felt like the natural next step. We're thankful to Target for sharing our passion and for their commitment to highlighting our authentic ingredients and origins. We've also made the mixed pack exclusive to Target, so it's the best place to try both flavors together and discover something new to enjoy just in time for the holidays.


Q:


Is expanding Almave into ready-to-drink non-alcoholic cocktails the beginning of a bigger vision for the brand? What can you see coming next?


A:


We're just getting started. The cans let us go where the bottle can't, which opens the door to new flavors and new places to find us. We'll keep listening to and creating with our drinkers along the way. We're looking forward to collaborating with partners who are just as unapologetic about choosing non-alcohlic options as we are, and I'm really excited for others to join us on our mission.


Q:


What’s in your Target cart?


A:


Have you seen my[Tiny Target](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IxnpQWV5Pic) ? I think that says it all!
